caller_asset_contract.notes: Every checkpoint, config, licence, rights record, runtime lock, cohort manifest, degradation manifest and parity vector must exist at an absolute path and match its declared SHA-256 before a caller may process audio. No upstream revision is pinned because the merged evidence records only a repository URL.

exact_blockers.requirement: Supply the VM-ASR source checkout at an immutable 40-hex revision under research/voice-enhancement-20261101/repos/vm-asr or data/checkouts/vm-asr; no checkout exists in the workspace.
Resolve https://github.com/ghnmqdtg/vm-asr to a full 40-hex commit and publish its per-file SHA-256 manifest; the merged evidence records only the repository URL.

Supply the exact inference checkpoint, model configuration and any state-space or tokenizer metadata with byte counts and SHA-256 values at one immutable revision; no weight was downloaded or identified by digest in the merged evidence.

Record the exact input and output sample rates, channels, low-pass cutoff, input duration limits, padding/crop recipe and any sample-rate conversion in a pinned config; no VM-ASR geometry is established by the merged evidence.
Provide an isolated hash-pinned runtime with a complete lock at data/envs/vm-asr/requirements.lock and a recorded platform; no environment, package pin or lock exists.
Add the upstream artifact licence and terms at the resolved commit; no licence file, terms statement or redistribution grant is recorded in the merged evidence or present in the workspace.

Clear weights, training-data, source-audio, clean high-band reference, output-use and redistribution rights, then freeze a rights-cleared paired band-limited/full-band speech cohort with bandwidth strata; only research-listed sibling material exists.

Produce one approved exact-runtime VM-ASR output on a frozen caller input plus high-band fidelity, content preservation and independent listening results; no local output, timing, benchmark or parity vector exists.

gates.requirement: The full 40-hex source revision, checkpoint, config and metadata SHA-256 values and the source licence match exact pins.
An isolated hash-pinned runtime with a complete lock is admitted on a recorded platform.
Source, weight, training-data, source-audio, clean-reference, output-use and redistribution rights are cleared with notices.
An approved exact-runtime VM-ASR output matches the reference on a frozen caller-supplied input for one frozen configuration.
A rights-cleared held-out cohort scores high-band fidelity, content preservation and intelligibility or listening as separate outcomes.
Input/output rates, cutoff, channels, duration and padding geometry are established and the candidate is not misrepresented as ASR.
Explicit opt-in provider intake, licence review, descriptor review and an independent public-surface decision are complete.
Explicit default selection, resource/deadline evidence and release or public-benchmark approval are recorded; this package is off by default.

qualification.reason: The VM-ASR source checkout, full upstream revision, inference weights, exact geometry and hash-pinned runtime are absent; no licence, rights record, rights-cleared paired band-limited/full-band cohort, degradation manifest, clean high-band reference, parity vector or local output exists.

restoration_profile_requirements.requirement: Freeze the low-pass corruption, cutoff, sample rates, channels and corresponding clean or full-band baseline.
Include the band-limited input identity and an established task-matched BWE baseline.
Stratify results by degradation, bandwidth and cutoff rather than pooling one condition.
Report validity, nonfinite failure and exact output intervals.
Score high-band fidelity and content preservation against permitted clean references.
Bound output peaks, duration and content/availability timing.
Record missing, invalid, nonfinite and adverse control results.

stable_fields.acceptance: Apply the restoration acceptance profile; record exact scope, evidence, failure/control results, and remaining release gates. A readiness conclusion with an exact external blocker is an accepted investigation handoff; it does not close the conditional implementation.
stable_fields.deliverable: Verify runnable source, exact assets, permitted scope, task geometry and matched evidence. Then implement or wrap a minimal reference using the relevant public adapter boundary and ship it as optional initially. Record a concrete blocker if feasibility fails.
stable_fields.title: Additional VM-ASR audio super-resolution
write_scope: SDK provider, tool or evidence directory for additional-vm-asr-audio-super-resolution and its own fixtures
